summary: GraphARC registry worst-case and remaining-headroom checks become a sealed but non-authoritative quote; incomplete, stale, or over-budget quotes cannot reserve or dispatch.
The existing hierarchical ledger owns ancestor reservation, pre-dispatch attempt debit, observed settlement, proof-backed release, anomaly, and reconciliation; graph-local meters remain adapters.
Budget mutation is authorized and appended first; fresh 036 consequence authorization binds its receipt and head, but neither predicate substitutes for the other.
Cross-process reservation correctness requires expected-head append under a current fence; thread locks and per-instance promise serialization are insufficient authority.
Retries, fan-out, cycles, approval waits, and resume preserve cumulative spend; every attempt debits before dispatch and capacity transfer requires release plus a new reservation.
Refund is only release of proven unused reservation; failed or observed spend remains committed, while missing or excess usage blocks ancestor admission until reconciliation.
Exhaustion routes to an explicit incomplete-budget-exhausted outcome with no implicit convergence, success, authorization denial, partial repair, or graph trimming.
